comment: The clock jack is not a trigger: SurgeModuleCommon.hpp:128 raises two to the power of its voltage to set the tempo, so 0V is 120 BPM and each volt doubles it. The gate input is what makes the module polyphonic: the number of channels on it is the number of voices, and pitch, velocity, polyphonic aftertouch and timbre are read a channel at a time to match. The audio outputs are always one channel.
